channel.title: Frontion News
channel.description: Breaking geopolitical headlines from Tier 1 sources

item.title: 🛢️📉 Oil prices plunge over 9% as US-Iran pause raises de-escalation hopes
item.description: Brent crude fell below $88 a barrel after the US halted attacks on Iran for a second consecutive night and Iran paused retaliatory strikes, sparking market optimism about a diplomatic resolution to the conflict.

item.title: 🇮🇷🇺🇦⚔️ Iran warns Ukraine of retaliation after deadly Caspian Sea strike on vessel
item.description: Iran Foreign Minister Araghchi said a Ukrainian attack on an Iranian commercial vessel in the Caspian Sea that killed one sailor cannot go unanswered, accusing Israel of provoking the strike to drag Europe into a wider conflict.

item.title: 🇺🇸🏛️ US appeals court upholds halt to Trump executive order creating federal voter list
item.description: A federal appeals court upheld a lower court ruling blocking Trump's order to create a federal citizenship list for voters and restrict mail ballot delivery, rejecting the administration's effort to implement it ahead of the November midterms.

item.title: 🇺🇦🚀 Ukrainian startup Fire Point mass-producing cruise missiles, striking deep into Russia
item.description: The Guardian reports Fire Point is manufacturing 100 Flamingo cruise missiles monthly and hundreds of drones daily, enabling Ukraine to sustain deep-strike operations inside Russia and closing the gap on Russian long-range attack capabilities.

item.title: 🇦🇷🇧🇷 Argentina Milei calls Brazil Lula a thief and convict at Bolsonaro campaign rally
item.description: Argentina president Javier Milei insulted Brazilian president Lula da Silva at a rally for Flavio Bolsonaro in Sao Paulo, prompting Brazil to recall its ambassador and escalating a diplomatic crisis between South America two largest economies.

item.title: 🇺🇸🇹🇼🇨🇳 US Congress approves $500M for Taiwan defense as Trump continues hesitating on arms package
item.description: The US House passed a bill including $500 million in Foreign Military Financing for Taiwan, signaling Congressional support even as President Trump withholds approval of a $14 billion weapons package after meeting Xi Jinping. Analysts say the allocation demonstrates Congress values Taiwan defense against Chinese expansion.

item.title: 🇺🇦🇺🇸🕊️ Ukraine and US coordinate new peace push, hoping Russia accepts air truce
item.description: Ukraine and the US are aligning on a new round of peace proposals to present to Moscow, with a US official saying the White House believes the Kremlin may now be more willing to accept at least a partial air ceasefire as Ukraine expands strikes inside Russia.

item.title: 🇺🇦🛩️⛽ Ukrainian drones strike export terminal and oil facilities in latest deep strike on Russia
item.description: Ukrainian drones hit an export terminal in Rostov-on-Don on the Black Sea and oil facilities in Udmurtia and Yaroslavl Oblast, over 1,300 km from Ukrainian territory. Two people were killed and five injured in the Rostov attack, the governor reported.

item.title: 🇬🇧🇺🇦🏛️ Britain’s new PM Burnham to host Zelensky as first foreign leader visit since taking office
item.description: New UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham will welcome Volodymyr Zelensky to London, making the Ukrainian president the first foreign leader to visit since Burnham replaced Keir Starmer. Zelensky is set to visit a British naval base and discuss continued defense support for Ukraine.

item.title: 🇮🇱🗳️⚔️ Israeli ex-army chief Eisenkot emerges as main rival to Netanyahu ahead of October election
item.description: Former military chief Gadi Eisenkot has surged as the principal challenger to Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of Israel’s October 27 general election. A Channel 12 poll puts his new Yashar party at 23 seats versus Likud’s 22, in what is widely seen as a referendum on Netanyahu’s leadership.

item.title: 🇺🇸🇮🇷🕊️ US and Iran pause strikes for third night as diplomatic efforts intensify
item.description: The US military has paused airstrikes on Iran for a third consecutive night, with the UN ambassador saying Trump is giving talks space. Iran halted retaliatory attacks in response. Oil prices fell below $90 per barrel after hitting $100 last week. Oman-mediated technical talks on the Strait of Hormuz are progressing.

item.title: 💰📉🇨🇳 Shein swings to $99m loss as Trump tariffs and Iran war hit sales
item.description: The fast-fashion giant posted a $99m first-quarter loss versus $395m profit a year earlier, as the removal of the US de minimis tariff exemption and the Iran war disrupted deliveries and demand. Shein also reported the Iran conflict increased costs and caused shipping delays across multiple markets.

item.title: 🕊️🛢️⚔️ Diplomatic off-ramp elusive as US-Iran war nears five months
item.description: NPR analysis: After 13 consecutive nights of US strikes on Iran, a pause has opened diplomatic space but both sides remain far apart on Strait of Hormuz control. Iran and Oman held technical talks in Tehran over the weekend. Trump says he is not in a hurry despite midterm pressure over gas prices. Netanyahu visits the White House on Tuesday.

item.title: 🔥☁️🇫🇷🇪🇸 Fire clouds threaten to worsen Europe wildfire crisis as new heatwave looms
item.description: Pyrocumulonimbus clouds, fire-generated thunderstorms that can create lightning and unpredictable winds, have been observed for the first time in France as wildfires ravage the country and Spain. Experts warn another heatwave with temperatures up to 40C could hit France from Tuesday, threatening to intensify the crisis that has already forced 330,000 evacuations.

item.title: 🇲🇱⚔️🌍 Mali's separatist-al-Qaeda alliance reshapes Sahel conflict
item.description: An unprecedented military partnership between the Azawad Liberation Front and al-Qaeda affiliate JNIM has transformed northern Mali conflict, with coordinated offensives challenging both the Malian army and Russia Africa Corps. The alliance poses the most serious battlefield threat to Bamako in years and has far-reaching implications for Sahel security.

item.title: 🇫🇷🇪🇸🔥 Macron convenes crisis meeting as wildfires threaten Bordeaux and ravage France-Spain
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron called an emergency cabinet meeting as wildfires closed to within 15km of Bordeaux, forcing over 220,000 evacuations. Spain simultaneously battles the largest wildfire in its recent history near Ávila, with 77,000 hectares scorched across both countries and 330,000 people evacuated total.

item.title: 🇺🇸💀 Three killed in shooting at Seattle food festival near Space Needle
item.description: A shooting at the Bite of Seattle food festival near the Space Needle left three dead and several injured, including a two-year-old boy. One suspect is in custody and police are searching for a second. Mayor Katie Wilson condemned the "horrific" violence.

item.title: 🇮🇳✊ India's Gen Z "Cockroach" protests force education minister to resign
item.description: India's education minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned after unprecedented youth-led protests by the Cockroach Janta Party swept the country, sparked by a leaked medical exam paper that forced 2 million students to retake tests. Analysts call it the first time in 12 years the Modi government lost control of the political narrative.

item.title: 🇸🇩⚔️ Sudan army recaptures strategic Khartoum-el-Obeid highway from RSF
item.description: Sudan's army announced it regained full control of the Al Sadarat highway linking Khartoum to the besieged city of el-Obeid, a key supply route held by the RSF since April 2023. The capture opens humanitarian access to 500,000 trapped civilians and blocks the RSF's push to seize North Kordofan.

item.title: 🇮🇱🇵🇸🔥 Israeli settlers torch mosques and homes in West Bank amid escalating violence
item.description: Israeli settlers set fire to two mosques, cars and farmland in the occupied West Bank overnight, Palestinian officials say, following a deadly clash that killed six people near the village of Tal. The IDF arrested over 130 Palestinians in weekend raids as Netanyahu vowed "powerful action."

item.title: 🇱🇾 Libya protests spread as civil disobedience campaign over power cuts paralyzes Tripoli
item.description: Protesters shut roads, foreign ministry, and telecoms offices in Libyas capital as a civil disobedience campaign against 10-hour daily blackouts and deteriorating services spreads. The Souq Al-Jumaa Movement vowed to completely paralyse the government.

item.title: 🇩🇪🇮🇱 German arms export licences for Israel surge amid submarine project focus
item.description: German arms export approvals for Israel have risen dramatically, with a significant portion tied to a submarine project. The surge marks the latest development in Germanys evolving military relationship with Israel.

item.title: 🇮🇷🇫🇷 Iran summons French ambassador over diplomat interference claims
item.description: Iran summoned the French ambassador to Tehran, accusing two French diplomats of interfering in Irans internal affairs under the pretext of civil society engagement. France says the diplomats were detained and physically abused by Iranian security services.

item.title: 🇵🇰🌧️ Pakistan monsoon floods kill over 100 as more rain forecast
item.description: Death toll from Pakistans monsoon rains and floods has surpassed 100, with Punjabs monsoon season expected to continue through September and more rainfall predicted this week.

item.title: 🇺🇦⚔️ Ukrainian drone unit hits 180 Russian vessels in Black Sea campaign
item.description: Ukrainian drone units operating behind front lines have struck over 180 Russian vessels and sea-borne targets around Crimea in recent weeks, opening a new maritime front in the war. The campaign aims to isolate Crimea and raise the cost of Russian occupation.
